query.text: 请看着我买东西，如果我找不到商品开口问你，请告诉我位置。
query.text_en: Please watch me shopping, and if I can't find an item and ask you, please tell me its location.

annotation.text_zh: 这里是零食和干货区，牛奶通常在冷藏区。
annotation.text_en: This is the snacks and dry goods section; milk is usually in the fridge.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
